title: Tiger cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="90" rx="28" ry="5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72 65 Q85 55 82 40 Q80 32 88 28" stroke="#ff8c00" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M82 40 Q80 32 88 28" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M76 50 l4 -3" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#ff8c00"/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d="M35 58 Q38 62 35 68" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 55 Q65 60 62 66" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 72 Q47 76 44 80" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 72 Q59 76 56 80" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="12" ry="11" fill="#ffd699"/>
  
  <!-- left leg (up, dancing) -->
  <path d="M36 78 Q30 85 26 82" stroke="#ff8c00" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="80" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#ffd699"/>
  
  <!-- right leg (down) -->
  <path d="M62 80 Q66 88 64 92" stroke="#ff8c00" stroke-width="7" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="92" rx="5" ry="4" fill="#ffd699"/>
  
  <!-- left arm (raised) -->
  <path d="M34 55 Q24 44 22 34" stroke="#ff8c00" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="32" r="4.5" fill="#ffd699"/>
  
  <!-- right arm (out, dancing) -->
  <path d="M66 58 Q76 52 82 48" stroke="#ff8c00" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="47" r="4.5" fill="#ffd699"/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="20" fill="#ff8c00"/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="22" r="7" fill="#ff8c00"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="22" r="4" fill="#ffb3b3"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="22" r="7" fill="#ff8c00"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="22" r="4" fill="#ffb3b3"/>
  
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d="M50 18 L50 24" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M40 20 L41 26" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 20 L59 26" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- cheeks/side stripes -->
  <path d="M30 38 L35 40" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M70 38 L65 40" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- face white area -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="12" ry="10" fill="#ffe6c7"/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="36" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a2a2a"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="35" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="36" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#2a2a2a"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="35" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d="M47 42 L53 42 L50 46 Z" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  
  <!-- mouth (happy) -->
  <path d="M50 46 Q46 50 43 47" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 46 Q54 50 57 47" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d="M36 42 L28 41" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M36 45 L28 46" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 42 L72 41" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 45 L72 46" stroke="#2a2a2a" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- music notes -->
  <path d="M88 60 L88 48 L94 46 L94 58" stroke="#ff69b4" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="61" r="3" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  <circle cx="92" cy="59" r="3" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  
  <path d="M12 65 L12 55 L17 53" stroke="#ff69b4" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="10" cy="66" r="2.5" fill="#ff69b4"/>
  
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d="M14 30 L15 27 L16 30 L15 33 Z" fill="#ffff66"/>
  <path d="M86 25 L87 22 L88 25 L87 28 Z" fill="#ffff66"/>
  <path d="M20 48 L21 46 L22 48 L21 50 Z" fill="#ffff66"/>
</svg>
